classification: Exploratory development experiment on previously inspected outcomes, not a virgin holdout or exact reproduction of the article.
data: Unchanged frozen research/data Tencent OHLCV, 2010-01-04 through 2026-08-31. Reuse round-3 valid observation table and execution labels. Missing amount is explicitly zero, not synthesized.
label: Actual open after next same-weekday signal / open after current signal - 1, using all completed daily training labels. All prediction signals are the 103 prior Friday anchors from 2024-07-05 through 2026-08-21.
validation: Only raw_fixed selects training epochs. Three annually expanding fits with cutoffs 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, evaluated on 141 Friday signals in 2018-2020 with labels completed by 2020-12-31. Pretrained tokenizer does not participate in pre-2024 historical validation.
development_schedule: All new models restart from initial weights at each cutoff, expand historical training, and use identical completed training observations. First mid-year cutoff accommodates paper-stated tokenizer pretraining end; thereafter annual refits match article cadence. No mid-period tuning.
raw_representation: log OHLC and log1p volume, each channel standardized within its observed 125-bar window; sd floor 1e-6. No fitting on test distribution.
tokenizer_representation: Official frozen Kronos-Tokenizer-base: normalize raw OHLCVA per observed 125-bar window using official float32 mean/std+1e-5, clip +/-5, with absent amount set to zero. Encode each window separately, never tokenize the complete time series. encode(half=True) followed by official indices_to_bits(half=True) yields 20 bipolar coordinates scaled by 1/sqrt(20), not numerical token IDs.
random_tokenizer: Identical official tokenizer architecture freshly initialized once with torch seed 20260913, held fixed for all observations and all downstream seeds. Same normalization, quantization and 20-coordinate interface. No random-model selection.

tokenizer_provenance.limitation: Reuse round-3 LFS-verified checkpoint; weight-specific training cutoff is not independently disclosed. Test timing relies on the paper statement and is not an availability-at-the-time reconstruction.

segmentation.fixed: 25 consecutive patches of five bars each.
segmentation.adaptive: Reuse frozen annual round-1 P0 and normalized reverse DTW boundaries: candidate length 5-25, minimum-total-path L1 cost normalized by that path length, leading remainder retained. Year-2024 prototypes are trained before 2024-01-01; 2025/2026 prototypes likewise use previous-year data.
segmentation.permuted: Use exactly the same adaptive length multiset, randomly reorder lengths with numpy default_rng(20260909+anchor), then segment the original chronological window. Maintains active patch count and lengths, disrupts shape-matched boundaries.
segmentation.interface: Linearly resample each patch to five points in its representation; right-align <=25 patches, zero-pad inactive slots, pass duration/125 and endpoint/125 plus a boolean validity mask. Interpolation of bipolar vectors is an explicit custom interface choice.

crossformer.components: Use upstream DSW embedding, temporal/dimension attention routers, two hierarchical encoder scales and three additive decoder layers, all trainable. Mask keys and suppress padded states through attention/merging. Learned two-coordinate patch geometry embedding is added to DSW embeddings.
crossformer.head: Flatten the five-by-input-dimension decoder outputs and apply one trainable scalar return readout. Initialize this readout to zero. These decoder coordinates are latent features, not claimed OHLC forecasts. Per-fold standardize execution-return labels using training mean/std and invert after prediction.
crossformer.fairness: Fixed/adaptive/permuted have identical parameter count and all optimizer settings within each representation. Pretrained/random tokenizer arms have identical downstream dimensions/parameter count. Raw vs tokenizer differs in input dimension and therefore a small number of positional/readout parameters; do not attribute that contrast solely to pretraining.

training.selection: Train raw_fixed on each validation fold and seed through 10 epochs; pool mean predictions across the three seeds at epochs 2/5/10. Select the smallest validation RMSE, ties prefer fewer epochs. Freeze one epoch count for every development arm and seed. If no validation improvement vs mean-return baseline, still report development as unqualified exploratory tests, never silently expand the budget.
training.shuffle: Only shuffle already-completed training samples. Use numpy default_rng(seed) permutations independent of model dimension; reset each model/fold from that seed. No random validation split.
training.determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, TF32 disabled, four CPU threads. Save every seed checkpoint and training curve. No test-based seed/epoch/threshold selection.

benchmarks: Ridge lambda=10 on prior 255 economic features, refit on exact new-model cutoffs and samples
unchanged round-3 quarterly Ridge and official Kronos OHLCV predictions for descriptive context
ensemble: Arithmetic mean of the three inverse-scaled scalar return predictions. Position long iff ensemble return > 0. Report all seed outcomes separately.
execution: Same frozen next-open persistent long/cash index proxy, zero cash interest, terminal liquidation 2026-08-31 open; flat start for each evaluated slice.
statistics: Reuse eight-observation circular block bootstrap with 10000 replicates, seed 20260910. Holm-adjust MSE tests across seven primary comparisons in each window. Direction and net-weekly-return uncertainty, per-year, per-seed and largest-week influence are exploratory diagnostics.
scope: Complete seven-arm masked Crossformer segmentation/tokenizer test. Does not reproduce missing 78-index P0, true amount, article default-size network or future OHLCAV head; no account/deployment changes.
